apis.name: Open Library
apis.description: Search books and read book, author and edition metadata from the Internet Archive's Open Library.

pricing.rateLimits: Unidentified requests: 1 per second. Identified requests (User-Agent with application name and contact email): 3 per second.
pricing.verificationNotes: Developer docs checked 2026-10-12: rate limits and usage guidelines confirmed. The page does not state pricing explicitly, so the pricing record stays "needs review".

limitations: Not intended as a bulk data backend or high-traffic commercial infrastructure; the provider points bulk users to data dumps.
The provider asks applications to identify themselves with a User-Agent that includes contact details, and to cache responses.
